M-DBG-OVERLAY.Purpose: Draw selected widget box layers and transient property-update highlights using engine geometry.

Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Geometry calculation, transform composition and clipping policy belong to FlexVerse.

Requirements.REQ-001: Overlays draw only during Repaint, never consume pointer input, mutate target layout or reconcile the target tree.
Requirements.REQ-002: Box edges use the resolved Flexbox node's margin, border and padding; visual placement uses TransformService.GetWorldMatrix and ancestor clips from ClipService.GetClips.
Requirements.REQ-003: Native GUI groups and matrix changes are balanced through finally, including when drawing fails.
Requirements.REQ-004: Heat intensity uses ChangeTracker.GetHeat with the configured duration.

Inputs.IN-001: Live engine, target widget and configured update heat.

Outputs.OUT-001: Native IMGUI overlay drawing in the target host context.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Issues native draw calls inside temporary balanced GUI scopes.
